segments.text: Gummy holds a bowling ball and a ping pong ball on the roof.
He's about to let go of both at once.
You'd guess the heavy one falls faster.
Earth pulls the heavy ball with more force.
But the heavy ball resists moving just as much.
Both the pull and the resistance grow by the same ratio.
So the weight cancels out, leaving only speed.
Without air resistance, both hit the ground at the same time.
